video.desc:
Mark, a top-tier elite lawyer, is forced to live with Alex, the guardian appointed by his late sister, for three months to fight for custody of his young nephew. Convinced Alex was the man who ruined his sister’s marriage, Mark’s chaotic battle over the child unravels into a shocking realization: Alex has never had feelings for his sister—he’s been pining for Mark all along. As Mark’s straight defenses crumble, his sleazy brother-in-law returns to seize the house and take the boy away. After teaming up to fend off the toxic ex, the two finally lay their hearts bare and build a family of three.
顶尖精英律师Mark为了争夺年幼外甥的抚养权，被迫与姐姐生前指定的监护人Alex同住三个月。
Mark一直认定，Alex就是毁掉姐姐婚姻的男人。可在这场围绕孩子展开的混乱争夺中，他却逐渐发现一个惊人的真相：Alex从未爱过他的姐姐，他真正暗恋多年的人，其实一直都是Mark。
随着Mark原本坚固的“直男防线”一点点瓦解，那个油腻无耻的姐夫又突然回来，企图夺走房子和孩子。
最终，Mark与Alex联手击退这个有毒前任，也终于向彼此坦白心意，和孩子一起组成了三口之家。
